articles.summary: Aptiv PLC (NYSE: APTV), a global industrial technology company, today announced it will present at UBS Global Industrials and Transportation Conference, December 2 at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. A simultaneous webcast will be available on the Aptiv Investor Relations website at ir.aptiv.com . About Aptiv Aptiv is a global industrial technology leader delivering advanced solutions people trust when it matters most across automotive, commercial vehicle, aerospace and defense, telecom and datacom, and other diversified industrial end markets. Our differentiated portfolio enables devices and systems to sense, think, act, and continuously optimize performance. Building on decades of innovation, Aptiv brings global scale and a resilient, localized value chain to customers across the globe. Learn more at aptiv.com . articles.summary: SCHAFFHAUSEN, Switzerland November 18, 2026 - Aptiv PLC (NYSE: APTV), a global industrial technology leader, was named a 2026 Automotive News PACE Award winner for multiple technologies. The prestigious award recognizes automotive suppliers for superior innovation, technological advancement, and business performance. At the awards ceremony November 17, Aptiv was recognized as a PACE award winner for both its Advanced Occupancy Classification (AOC) and Emergency Power Module (EPM). The Aptiv PULSE(tm) Sensor was also selected as a PACE Pilot award winner. Advanced Occupancy Classification is the industrys first occupant detection system powered entirely by the vehicles interior camera. Using AI and computer vision, it classifies occupants by size, posture and seating position to support safer airbag deployment decisions, including suppression for children and out-of-position occupants. articles.summary: Aptiv Accelerates Robotics Expansion With Industry Partners Deepens Collaboration with TARS and Shanghai Electric for Robotics Technology Integration and Application Into Manufacturing Operations SHANGHAI, China - November 6, 2026 Aptiv (NYSE: APTV), a global industrial technology company, signed separate strategic collaboration agreements with TARS and Shanghai Electric during the 9th China International Import Expo (CIIE), expanding Aptivs presence in physical AI solutions for industrial applications. The partnerships bring robots into Aptivs manufacturing operations while integrating Aptiv products and technologies into new robotic platforms. Real-world manufacturing environments are critical to the development and commercialization of physical AI technologies. Aptiv brings extensive manufacturing, engineering and production expertise to help validate and refine these technologies.
